# MailVault

> MailVault is a free, private desktop email app for macOS, Windows and Linux. It reads, sends and searches mail from Gmail, Microsoft 365, Outlook.com, IMAP and JMAP accounts, and can keep an independent archive on your own computer in Maildir (plain .eml files) or JMAP storage (original message bytes and JSON records). Archive the messages explicitly, open saved messages and attachments, and verify a separate backup before deleting server mail; the inbox cache alone is not proof of a complete archive. There is no MailVault account and no MailVault server in the path of your mail. Premium ($4/month or $25/year) adds scheduled backups, tracker removal, Time Capsule, cleanup rules, migration, the one-step Archive & Delete and Archive, Back up & Delete (which also checks a copy on your backup drive before removing mail from the server), two whole-account jobs in Settings > Backup & Restore, Archive, back up & delete from server and Archive & delete from server (choose folders and years, every copy checked before anything leaves the server), Privacy mode (masks names, addresses and phone numbers in the app, with redacted and social image export), a check at Send for an attachment you mentioned but forgot, a reminder when a sent email gets no reply, and Hoarder, a download mode that keeps every folder's full history on the computer instead of a recent window.

## Optional

- [Blog](https://mailvaultapp.com/blog.html)

Released features also include a local Contacts address book with vCard import/export and merge/undo, Notes to Self, and verification-code bubbles. Fastmail JMAP setup uses an API token with Mail and Submission access. Cleanup uses local rules and Naive Bayes without an LLM download. AI writing supports configurable endpoints, but Gmail mail is processed only on this computer.
